metadata.title: Test fixture: a partner token that is a SUBSTRING of another drug's name
metadata.note: Reproduces the live shape from issue #115/#86 — the token 'iron' sits inside 'spironolactone', so hasActiveDrug's substring matching reports a patient on spironolactone alone as also being on iron. Pins that interaction screening needs a SECOND active order to raise a pair, so one order cannot pair with itself. Real KB ids/rxcuis/ATC codes; shaped like ddi-severity-floor-pair.json.

7199.text: Coadministration with medications containing polyvalent cations may decrease the oral bioavailability of either agent by forming insoluble chelates.
